description.value: MR MIKES Chilliwack is a location of the long-running Canadian SteakhouseCasual chain, originally founded in 1960 and positioned as a relaxed, unpretentious full-service restaurant. The menu spans premium steaks, burgers, pastas, salads, and shareable appetizers in a casual 'come as you are' atmosphere. Walk-ins are welcome, and both dine-in and takeout options are available at this Sardis-area location.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active MR MIKES Steakhouse Casual at 45200 Luckakuck Way, Chilliwack, BC V2R 3C7, matching OSM address and phone number. The location page explicitly lists 'Order for Takeout' as an option, confirming takeout availability. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, wi-fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
